name: Venomancer: Beetle Poison adds a Wicked Poison stack and Rapid Injection speeds its ticks (#2876, #2922)
contract: #2876 and #2922: Beetle Poison (705876) is a flat SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS (31) +1 on Wicked Poison (705985, family 35 word2 0x20000, StackAmount 1), read by SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks. Rapid Injection (705989) is a PCT SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (19) -30% on word2 0x820000 (Wicked Poison and Venomtip Poison), read by AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic on the 1500 ms Wicked Poison amplitude. Native modifier queries only: no Wicked Poison application is submitted, so the applied stack count and tick timing are not exercised here.

steps.label: Wicked Poison stacks once without Beetle Poison
Wicked Poison ticks every 1500 ms without Rapid Injection
Expulsion (outside Rapid Injection's mask) keeps its period
Beetle Poison lets Wicked Poison stack twice
DIAGNOSTIC: Rapid Injection is applied as a passive aura after learn
Rapid Injection shortens the Wicked Poison tick to 1050 ms
Rapid Injection does not touch Expulsion's period
Beetle Poison still gives exactly two Wicked Poison stacks
